newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: AMPLATS SEES PLATINUM IN $390-430 RANGE.
newsitem.headline: AMPLATS SEES PLATINUM IN $390-430 RANGE.

text.p: South Africa's Anglo American Platinum Corp Ltd said on Friday it expected platinum prices to trade in a range between $390 and $430 an ounce in its current financial year, ending June 30, 1997.

"As regards the current financial year, informed opinion suggests that the strength of underlying demand will keep the price above $390 per ounce but that the elasticity of supplies from Russia's platinum stockpile will impose a ceiling at around $430 per ounce," chairman Leslie Boyd said in his annual statement.

Boyd repeated a previous estimate that an illegal strike at the company's Rustenburg Platinum Mines earlier this year had cost 100,000 oz in lost productuon with a consequent loss of revenue of some 264 million rand.

The impact of the the strike, which will affect the first month of the current financial year, was currently being assessed. Amplats' earnings for 1996/97 were likely to be similar to those of 1995/96, although the continued weakening of the rand could alter prospects, Boyd added.
